messages:
mira: quick dump from the GPTQ bakeoff heatmap across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. attached csv + a tiny ascii heatmap. goal: call out accuracy deltas vs FP16 and surface deployment perf tradeoffs.
jonah: awesome — can you list the top regressions (>2% absolute) and which quant flows caused them?
mira: top regressions: Llama-2-13B GPTQ-4bit (one-shot) -> -3.8% avg on MMLU subset; Llama-2-13B AWQ-4 had -2.3% on reasoning subset. Mistral-7B GPTQ-4 showed -2.6% on multi-hop qa. Qwen-7B GPTQ-4 is mostly stable (-0.3%) but GSM8K math failures spiked on specific seeds.
claire: numbers are we talking EM or overall accuracy? also any precision/recall splits?
mira: mostly accuracy/average pass@ on benchmarks we run (MMLU, GSM8K, TruthfulQA subset). EM-specific: Llama-2-13B GPTQ-4 EM drop ~4.1 points on MMLU-fact set.
ryan: infra notes: AWQ (int8-ish path) shows ~12% faster single-stream decode on A100/A10G due to int kernels; GPTQ frequently needs larger KV-cache footprint (quant shadow) which bumps memory by ~0.5–1.2GB at 13B. That KV overhead hurts batched throughput in our current runtime.
mira: deployment profiles: recommended canary policies — run AWQ-8 canary on latency-sensitive endpoints; reserve GPTQ-4 for cost-sensitive background jobs where a small perf delta is acceptable. For Llama-13B we recommend fallback to FP16 for canary failures.
dev-bot: deploy: canary started for mistral7b-awq8 -> route 5% traffic to dedicated-canary pool (job id: deploy-1987).
sam: link to raw artifacts + heatmap: https://internal.redwood/reports/quant-bakeoff/1987654321 (csv, heatmaps, per-seed traces).
gabe: curious about calibration/quant params — what group sizes did GPTQ use? and were per-channel/isotropic scales applied?
mira: GPTQ runs: group_size=128 default for 4-bit runs, per-channel scales. We also tried group_size=64 on Mistral which reduced some regressions (~0.6% gain) but increased model size by ~30MB. AWQ used asymmetric int8 with per-tensor scales for speed path.
jonah: (typo?)
jonah: :eyes: can we get a small set of failing prompts (5-10) for each major regression so eval team can triage?
mira: yes — I'll push a condensed failure-set artifact tonight. plan: rerun top-3 regressions with group_size 64/32 and with/without outlier removal, then run instruction-following eval.
claire: please add a quick blurb for the release notes: include recommended runtime knobs (group_size, kv-cache-policy) and a short note: "Llama-13B GPTQ-4 reduces cost by ~2.8x but expect up-to 3.8% accuracy delta on MMLU; use canary and fallback to FP16 for critical flows."
ryan: ops action: add GPU mem alert for canary pool (threshold +1GB over baseline) to catch KV blowups.
dev-bot: job deploy-1987: canary health=passing, latency p95 +7ms vs baseline.
sam: next steps for ML: run targeted instruction eval and rerun GSM8K seeds for Qwen to see if math regressions are stable. ops: schedule a larger dedicated-run on A10G for throughput numbers.
gabe: thanks — looks actionable. happy to help triage failure cases tomorrow.
